exposure: Intravenous patient-controlled analgesia (IV PCA; IVA) regimen
basal rate 15.00 mcg/hours, bolus dose 15.00 mcg, total volume 100 mL
basal rate 31.25 mcg/hours, bolus dose 31.25 mcg, nefopam 60 mg, paracetamol 3 g, total volume 160 mL
cohort: 631 patients who underwent elective cesarean section and received intravenous patient-controlled analgesia (IVA)
finding: The study found that a higher initial basal rate of IVA after elective cesarean section led to a significant decrease in the second prescription rate without increasing adverse events.
